:::{#def-column-vector}
#### Column vector

A **column vector**
[@wikipedia_row_and_column_vectors]
of length $p$ is an ordered list of $p$ [real numbers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers), <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
written vertically as a $p \times 1$ array:

$$
\vx =
\begin{bmatrix}
x_{1} \\
x_{2} \\
\vdots \\
x_{p}
\end{bmatrix}
$$

:::
